messages:
maria: Heads-up — seeing intermittent 401s from payment-service after the CI deploy at 15:12 UTC. ~0.3% of requests. Error body: {\"code\":\"invalid_api_key\", \"detail\":\"key not found\"}. Not seeing a high error rate but customers reported failures.

aj: Which key are they presenting? Can you repro locally or share a curl example?

maria: Repro on staging:

curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/charge
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{\"code\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"message\":\"key not found\"}

Sample of what I saw on prod edge logs:
[edge-proxy] 2026-02-28T15:17:22Z GET /v1/charge 401 \"invalid_api_key\" src=10.2.5.1 svc=payment-service env=prod

I exec'd into one payment-service pod and checked environment:
kubectl -n prod get secret payment-service-env -o yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: payment-service-env
data:
  API_KEY: OLDKEY_BASE64==

echo \"$API_KEY\" | base64 --decode
OLD-LEGACY-KEY-xxxx

Vault path we use: secret/data/prod/payment-service (managed by release job). Last write appears at 2026-02-28T15:10:02Z (the deploy window). But vault-agent on the pod showed no refresh logs. I suspect the pod got mounted with an env secret at deploy time that shadowed the vault-injected value.

deploy-bot: deployment payment-service v2.3.1 completed (commit abc123) at 2026-02-28T15:12:05Z

sasha: quick check — our overlay repo still has .secrets/prod.env committed (shouldn't) with API_KEY=OLD-LEGACY-KEY-xxxx. CI overlay job applies repo env files after vault sync due to a precedence bug (we thought vault overrides repo, but overlay step order is reversed). That explains why pods start with OLD key even though vault was rotated.

aj: Ok that matches. Two issues then: (1) repo-stored secret shadowing vault value during deploy, (2) pods may cache a previous key via vault-sidecar/agent. What did you try to mitigate?

maria: Quick mitigation: rotated the legacy key in the internal keystore to a disabled state and applied a one-off restart of payment-service pods. After restart I saw the new key from vault mounted and the 401s dropped to 0 within ~30s. Confirmed by curl and edge logs.

Command used to restart pods:
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/payment-service

I also hit the vault-agent debug log in one pod:
[2026-02-28T15:12:40Z] vault-agent: no change detected for path secret/data/prod/payment-service (last polled 2026-02-28T15:10:02Z)
[2026-02-28T15:12:50Z] vault-agent: refresh interval 60s (default)

kevin: For a durable fix: we should (a) remove any committed secrets from the overlay repo and add a linter check to fail CI if .secrets/* exists; (b) change deploy order so vault sync occurs after overlays, or better: inject env from projected volume that vault-agent writes to with higher precedence; (c) bump vault-agent to force immediate refresh on deploy and add a post-deploy restart hook.

support: Impacted customers list: 3 customers reported payments failing between 15:15–15:20 UTC. Opened support ticket TICKET-8731 and notified billing ops to review failed charges and offer refunds if needed.

aj: Thanks — can you add a minimal repro doc so on-call can diagnose faster next time? Include exact commands you ran and the three checks (kubectl secret, base64 decode, vault path last-write). Also include the overlay path that caused the shadowing.

maria: Adding repro steps in the incident thread and will push a PR to delete .secrets/prod.env from repo and add the linter. Steps I used:
1) kubectl -n prod get secret payment-service-env -o yaml | grep API_KEY
2) echo \"OLDKEY_BASE64==\" | base64 --decode
3) curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <that key>\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/charge
4) kubectl -n prod exec -it <pod> -- cat /var/run/vault/secret/payment-service | jq .API_KEY

kevin: I'll follow up with infra PR to change post-deploy ordering and add a restart hook. Also propose adding an automated check in the release job to compare repo-stored secrets against vault and fail the deploy if they differ.

maria: Confirmed fix — restarted pods at 15:16, 401s stopped by 15:17. Filing a short postmortem and remediation actions.

aj: Great. Assigning follow-up tickets: INFRA-1204 (deploy ordering + hook), DX-442 (repo linter to block committed secrets), SUPPORT-8731 (customer outreach). Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
